answer: What keeps this honest is finality via two-thirds supermajority of graders, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. A farm running 604 aliases would need 604 separate proofs, each costing about 104 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The pearl of the design is public, the reef of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the harbor of honest work is what finally pays. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
